status: predeclared first offline optimization round; no production activation
purpose: reduce the absolute difference between an earlier sampling-time prediction and its subsequently available assay

source.policy: verify phase1 manifest and all its data/source hashes before fitting and after export; never modify source artifacts; never access production from this experiment

cohort.eligibility: frozen phase1 common_valid, original strict, fixed seven factors strict, same primary six-switch group
cohort.two_system: report 5/4/3 rows separately as coverage gaps; no fitting or borrowing three-system coefficients; core returns unsupported_group for every other group

availability.strict_comparison: sample_at < prediction_at and version_available_at < prediction_at; same-time versions are excluded; explicitly exclude the current target assay_id irrespective of supplied times
availability.versioning: require version_id and availability evidence; choose latest available version per assay_id; never choose a later version because its initial created_at was earlier
availability.historical_entry_proxy: ONLY for development/exploratory replay: version_available_at is initial created_at; final values may have been revised, so this is not certified as-of information
availability.historical_midnight_proxy: fixed sensitivity replay with prediction cutoff at Asia/Shanghai 00:00 of target date, using observed_at and initial created_at strictly before cutoff; same revision limitation
availability.formal_seed: old frozen final labels become demonstrably available only at seed_snapshot_available_at; their original created_at is not used to backdate final values
availability.new_values: use immutable measured-version availability or an actual captured snapshot time; without revision evidence final database values are available no earlier than that snapshot capture
availability.target_rule: 12:00 sample with 13:00 result is scored against the frozen 12:00 prediction; the result can update predictions strictly after 13:00; it cannot change its own prediction
availability.feature_as_of: all target input evidence must have received_at <= sample_at; lagged level is selected at sample_at-90s by received_at, latest-at-or-before, max lookback 30s; no future interpolation
availability.timestamps: timezone-aware ISO8601 only, UTC normalized internally; keep source and received clock fields as provenance
availability.clock_domain_rule: core numeric comparisons require caller-supplied timestamps in one verified clock domain; old audit capture is notebook clock whereas sampling/feature timestamps are host clock; never back-correct old times using today's offset; formal runtime must conservatively re-seal seed availability in its host clock; reconstructed holdout discloses this clock limitation

common_training.scope: all available primary-group raw labels, with no seven-day truncation, used ONCE per target to calculate the shared fence; all candidates and target normal-membership share it
common_training.gate_interpretation: operational fitting gate, not a statistical accuracy sample-size requirement; below gate returns no usable fitted prediction with a reason
common_training.recent_selection: after the common fence, select normal labels sampled within the preceding 168h, sort by sample_at then assay_id then version_id, then take the last declared count; C7 first validates the available receipts in this seven-day normal pool, then takes the last 5 valid residuals, rather than taking 5 labels before filtering receipts; do not sort recency by late entry time
common_training.all_labels_retained: every raw/excluded label and reason is exported; test normal membership comes only from its prior-training fence

C3.training: all common normal available history; no seven-day truncation
C3.weighted_median_tie: average adjacent values if cumulative weight equals half within 1e-12 relative weight

C5.training: all common normal available history; no seven-day truncation

C6.training: all common normal available history; no seven-day truncation

C7.current_baseline: first reject a nonfinite current C5 raw value, clip that C5 value to [0,100], add the declared bias to this clipped baseline, record this sum as C7 raw_prediction, then clip C7 uniformly to [0,100]
C7.residual_evidence: C5 prediction and complete fitted state frozen without label_i; receipt embeds final clipped prediction, original issue/sample time, immutable state, issued features and feature hash, training IDs/version IDs, latest label availability and receipt hash; validator replays the prediction and checks state/input/version/group identity; no changing a receipt time or its frozen inputs when a label arrives
C7.formal_sample_association: formal shadow may append a separately hashed, registry-verified association binding the unchanged issued receipt, prediction event, post-persistence host seal and specific label version/event hash; input_asof<=postseal<actual_sample<=input_asof+30s, same group/host clock domain/epoch, association availability strictly before fit cutoff; association itself must be persisted before its availability host seal; no registry verification means reject; a later label revision needs its own valid association; separately retain issued-input and training-input hashes/times and never pretend nominal 90s relative to issue time is exactly 90s relative to later sample
C7.historical_sample_association: historical proxy replay uses exact sample/features binding only and never fabricates a formal association
C7.fallback: zero bias if fewer than 3 eligible receipts; never reconstruct a missing receipt from a later fit

huber_ridge.slope_constraints: none; slope may have either sign; no candidate-specific feature clipping
huber_ridge.solver: deterministic IRLS; Huber weights apply only to real data residuals, ridge always remains pure quadratic
huber_ridge.failure_policy: return no prediction on solver failure/nonfinite output; report coverage, never silently select a rescue model

output_values.action: first reject nonfinite raw values, never rescue them by clipping; all finite C0..C7 predictions are uniformly clipped to [0,100] after fitting and calibration; raw_prediction records the unclipped composite value; prediction/value record the clipped value; selection uses final prediction only; report both raw and final errors/MAE
output_values.frozen_reference: preserve its original clamps and corrections unchanged
output_values.extrapolation: flag outside fitted normal-training predictor range; retain and score finite predictions

references.frozen_expert8: unchanged frozen formula evaluated on same raw target inputs; offline recomputation, not an archived production decision
references.last_observed: most recently sampled raw eligible available assay version, without normal-fence filtering or a seven-day age limit; if no legal value use C0; descriptive reference only, not a selectable ninth candidate

historical_experiment.sensitivity_availability: historical_midnight_proxy at target date 00:00 Asia/Shanghai; same matrix, no reselection
historical_experiment.selection: rank C0..C7 on identical predicted development IDs by normal sample MAE, then all-sample MAE, normal date-balanced MAE, then declared complexity_rank; numeric tie epsilon=1e-9
historical_experiment.coverage_gate: a selectable candidate must predict every common eligible development target with no less coverage than C0; report native and common coverage before scores
historical_experiment.later_data: 10/26-10/31 already-viewed historical diagnostic only; no selecting candidates using this later segment
historical_experiment.full_fit: refit the single selected method on all 34 frozen primary labels at a cutoff strictly after seed_snapshot_available_at; this is an artifact, not an accuracy estimate
historical_experiment.C7_historical_receipts: generate C5 once at each sample_at using only that historical proxy's earlier available labels; save full states and receipts before using subsequently available residuals; midnight sensitivity uses its own earlier-midnight C5 states but receipt preserves the actual sample_at_i; evidence_mode is the matching exploratory historical proxy mode and these receipts are forbidden in formal candidate/holdout/runtime state
historical_experiment.C7_formal_cold_start: the 34 frozen seed labels carry no formal C5 receipt; the initial formal residual pool is empty and offset is zero; only at least 3 truly saved legal pre-assay C5 receipts plus subsequently available labels can activate a formal bias; do not import exploratory receipts or retrospectively reconstruct missing formal receipts

new_holdout.confirmed_metadata_exclusion: user confirmed ID197 has an erroneous sampling time before any new assay values were revealed; exclude it from fitting/validation, retain raw record and exclusion reason, do not correct time or delete production data; do not generalize this confirmation into an automatic rule that every observed_at>created_at is erroneous
new_holdout.lock_before_reveal: freeze this protocol, candidate identity/configuration and code before revealing any post-audit assay values; input/target metadata may be audited without values
new_holdout.no_selection: post-audit labels do not participate in this first-round candidate selection or rescue tuning
new_holdout.reconstructed_holdout: previously unseen label period can be historical holdout after reconstruction; reconstructed input and prediction now are not prospective online evidence
new_holdout.formal_causality: old labels use seed snapshot availability; later labels update only from proven version/snapshot availability; if no label version existed before a holdout target it cannot calibrate it
new_holdout.rolling: a holdout label may affect strictly later targets only after its proven availability; freeze and hash each prediction before opening that target's label for scoring
new_holdout.prospective_online: only a running shadow that actually saves a prediction before receiving the assay can produce prospective online evidence
new_holdout.evidence_threshold: report paired differences and sample/date coverage; no fixed small n proves 80 percent; if coverage or independent dates are inadequate mark the conclusion provisional

metrics.primary: MAE in ash percentage points; normal and all samples, per-sample and date-balanced
metrics.uncertainty: Wilson95 for hit1; paired date-block bootstrap of candidate-minus-reference MAE with fixed seed=20261102 and 10000 draws; exploratory historical intervals are descriptive
metrics.coverage: all/strict/ineligible, predicted/rejected/fallback, assay IDs, dates, input ranges, per-group and all excluded targets retained
metrics.comparison: paired identical target IDs against frozen expert8, C0 and last_observed; report each date and all failure points
metrics.acceptance: historical improvement supports a candidate only, not proof of future accuracy; an unseen holdout improvement requires lower paired MAE than frozen expert8 and no worse than C0 with coverage and uncertainty disclosed; 80 percent within +/-1 remains a separate unproven stage target unless adequate new evidence supports it

required_invariants: Changing the current target label never changes its own prediction or fitted state
Adding/changing future label values never changes an earlier fitted state or prediction
13:00 entry for a 12:00 sample is unavailable at 12:00 and at exactly13:00, eligible strictly after13:00
Later label revisions never replace earlier versions before their own availability
C7 never creates historical residuals with a later or in-sample C5 fit
All candidates share raw training IDs, label-version IDs and the one common target fence
Two-system groups never receive primary three-system trained coefficients
Serialized state and receipts replay deterministically with hashes and training provenance
Frozen phase1, EXPERT8 model/implementation, production timing and production configuration remain unchanged
stopping: run this fixed round once; no extra feature windows, lag selection, polynomial, parameter grid, hidden ensemble or extra candidate; a later experiment requires a newly declared protocol before new fitting and no reuse of revealed holdout as unseen evidence
outputs: locked protocol+hash; source/input hashes; versioned seed/events; every fold state/fence/training and receipt IDs; prequential receipts; all predictions and exclusions; selection; native/common normal/all/per-date metrics and uncertainty; reusable offline EXPERT8.1 candidate artifact; report; synthetic causal tests; no activation/deployment/automatic density control
